verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway and Catalog features focus on routing, governing, and cataloging LLM/MCP/API traffic, not on generating AI-driven insights or suggestions from the customer's own operational data (e.g., analytics, anomaly detection, natural-language querying of traffic). No evidence pack item describes such a feature. Missing for 10: any documentation of AI-generated insights/recommendations surfaced to users from their own API/traffic data, dashboards with AI summarization, or copilot-style analytics inside Kong Manager/Konnect.
